verdict.rationale: Elastic publishes an official MCP server (elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch) and official skills that teach AI coding agents how to work with Elasticsearch, Kibana and Fleet. A user can therefore drive the product in natural language, but only through an external AI agent, and the evidence never shows a native natural-language command interface. missing for 10: a first-party in-product natural-language interface for querying and administration, documentation of which operations the MCP server and skills actually cover, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works.
